cohort: 1200 participants examined at a tertiary care hospital in Lodhran district, Punjab, Pakistan from 2019-2021 with diagnosed cases of maternal deaths due to sepsis reported from different tertiary care hospitals.
finding: Group A Streptococcus (Streptococcus pyogenes strains) were the most common causative agents (53.33%) of maternal sepsis leading to death.
mod_finding: Different approaches of delivery were significantly associated with sepsis.
